question: Can rigorous continuous receiver bounds certify K, B1 and B2 for every saved geometry/taxon response, and bound each saved native reference error, under the declared fixed law and resources?

input_selection.geometry: Join result.geometry by exact core/taxon; retain lexical saved anchor_order and both serialized anchor_xy_m values. Join radius by protocol.cores.id. Reject missing, duplicate, foreign or inconsistent owners and cross-taxon anchor disagreement.
input_selection.physical: Use original protocol.physical and result.axis/fall_speed_m_s; exponent turbulence_parameter/2 must equal exactly 1/8.
input_selection.finite_model: Parse each saved integer or binary64 parameter as its exact dyadic rational. No coordinate reprojection, radius change, age/count input, anchor re-inversion or new forecast.
input_selection.exposure: These are previously exposed development metadata and numerical references. Existing files contain old summaries; only declared mathematical fields are consumed, and no untouched-target claim is made.

survival_law.formula: S(d)=exp(-A*d^(1/8)) for nonnegative displacement d. Uniform disk receiver radius R and source annulus [R,L], with all fixed source anchors.
survival_law.native_prefix: For each of the two source fall speeds, capture float(gpm_values(1.0, fall, diffusion, turbulence, wind)) once, require 0<S1<1, then A=-math.log(S1)>0 finite. Reuse that same captured A across its three core cases.
survival_law.exact_capture: Persist S1 and A as float.hex and exact numerator/denominator, plus literal input floats and current Python/NumPy/platform identity. These values define the new continuous law before integration.
survival_law.historical_limit: The old A bit patterns were not saved; this new capture does not authenticate their historical identity. Do not replace captured A with a newly evaluated analytical coefficient.
survival_law.floating_limit: The ideal captured-A integral is distinct from every old floating operation and the native q=745 truncation. Omitted positive survival mass above745 is less than2^-745; old numerical point error is checked separately.

method.arithmetic: Exact rational outward operations on the existing96-bit lattice, certified elementary remainders and analytic derivatives through8 (underlying h through9).
method.partition_contract: Exact original-R bands [2^jR,min(2^(j+1)R,L)]; at most11bands, no uncovered tail. Contact Duffy only in first band; scaled regular squares thereafter. Retain original Q(R),Q(L) only.
method.coverage: Close every initial domain for the declared six-case population before any adaptive refinement. Preserve each case owner and incomplete/not-executed reason if global time or resources prevent initial coverage. Retain each parent until both children close; no partial sum is a whole-response certificate.

allocations.total_radial_full_width: epsilon/8 divided equally over all radial domains before evaluation

method.refinement: One global deterministic frontier over closed case/domain states. Choose the unqualified case with greatest max(K,B1,B2 full width)/epsilon (ties fixed case order), then its greatest weighted leaf width: endpoint contribution weight2, radial contribution weight1 (ties domain/creation order). Bisect the direction with greatest certified directional remainder. Freeze an exhausted case but continue other cases under the SAME global clock. No saved-point error, old score or count drives refinement.
method.stopping: A completely covered case stops when all three actual final full widths meet epsilon. Record individual auxiliary allocation targets separately; they do not override a valid final-width result or relabel any earlier backend/probe refusal.

acceptance.coefficient_certificate: Original input ownership and complete valid outward-domain coverage, with each final full coefficient width<=1/1000000000. Retain all18results/refusals; do not drop or renormalize cases.
acceptance.allocator_status: Keep backend status and all local allocation checks separately. A local allocation is a conservative stopping target; numerical precision of a complete coefficient is decided by its actual final full width, never by relabeling a backend refusal.
acceptance.saved_point_absolute_error: For each saved scalar x and complete interval[lo,hi], compute max(abs(x-lo),abs(x-hi)) and require<=1/1000000000 before claiming that saved point is certified to that absolute accuracy.
acceptance.saved_point_correspondence: Separately retain the original1e-9+1e-8*abs(x) comparison. Do not substitute it for the absolute-error claim.
acceptance.reference_population: Per case retain standalone homogeneousK, primary homogeneousK, exact sum of the two serialized primary anchor factors, and the two individual anchor factors. These are distinct finite references.
acceptance.positivity: Record positive-bound usability separately from final-width certification; no clipping or imputed positive lower bound.
acceptance.no_promotion: No historical/core/shoreline/taxon admission, vegetation accuracy, field recommendation, posterior uncertainty, updated prediction/score or whole original scientific outcome follows.

resources.on_exhaustion: Retain every closed case/domain certificate and every declared case status, including incomplete or not-executed owners; do not retry, enlarge bounds/tolerance/resources, or call the full population accepted.
resources.clock: All case budgets share the one study start and160-second integration-work deadline; no per-case wall-time reset. Whole-process180-second wall and posthoc RSS/output checks include closure; retain partial states honestly.

independent_verification.inputs: Bind every emitted geometry/native-prefix/case owner to these exact declared inputs and capture before checking arithmetic. Metadata alone is not authentication.
independent_verification.mathematics: Use the independently established disk-overlap/Q identity, Duffy/scaled-band changes of variables, exact positive Peano kernels and meaningful independent primitive/derivative controls.
independent_verification.closed_results: Inspect all declared cases and exact boundaries, nonoverlap/coverage, rule identities, local enclosures/radii/96-bit rounding, global sums, complementary B2, widths and all saved-reference comparisons without adaptive re-integration. Retain any remaining primitive-reevaluation limitation explicitly.

source_limits: Static circular radii and saved planar coordinates remain conditional hypotheses, not authenticated historical geometry. Original source/core/taxonomy/rights/independent-vegetation questions retain their owning accounts. No raw count table or private author workbook is consumed or redistributed.
